set.body: PRD C-5, C-6. monotoneLattice is an O(nm) dynamic program — the lattice is a DAG topologically ordered by i+j, so eyesim's igraph Dijkstra was never required. The library has no graph dependency for alignment.
set.title: Alignment abstraction: monotoneLattice DP, Needleman-Wunsch, DTW, Frechet
